## par-p01-v01 — argument map

Veneration to Śiva, whose self is all tattvas without remainder (oṃ namaḥ śivāya nikhilatattvātmane). The work avowed: the Entering-into-the-Supreme, Kṣemarāja-composed (atha parāprāveśikā ...viracitā). The vow: consciousness venerated as the Lord's heart — world-formed yet transcending, throbbing as supreme power.

### Open
- Authorship: KSTS/Muktabodha ascribe to Kṣemarāja; Hareesh ascribes to Nāgānanda — edition followed, dispute logged (internal maṅgala + colophon support the edition).
- Parādi read as supreme-etc. (threefold Śakti scale), not expanded.
